When enabled, items in the Global Ignore List will be skipped during auto-gathering.
When enabled, automatically store gathered building materials into shulker boxes when inventory is full, then resume auto-gathering.

How to store materials into shulker boxes.
Simulate: place/open/mine the shulker box normally.
QuickShulker: open directly from inventory via QuickShulker API (requires QuickShulker mod on both client and server).
Items to ignore during auto-gathering. Click to open the list editor. Default: minecraft:water_bucket + all shulker box variants.

Scan radius in blocks for finding waterloggable blocks. Clamped to player reach distance. Range: 0-5, default: 5.

Delay in ticks between closing one container and opening the next during auto-caching. Range: 1-200, default: 1.

playercontrolpp.message.recording.corrup: [PlayerControl++] Recording file is corrupt or damaged and cannot be loaded.
Teleport the player back onto the recorded path when playback drifts more than 2 blocks.
OFF by default: playback reproduces input, not positions, so some drift is normal. Correcting it rewrites the client position, which disagrees with the server and may look like flying to anti-cheat. Recommended for single-player only.
playercontrolpp.message.playback.drift: [PlayerControl++] Playback has drifted well off the recorded path (terrain or latency). Enable Playback Position Correction in settings if you want it snapped back.
playercontrolpp.message.recording.index_: [PlayerControl++] The recording index could not be read and has been set aside as index.json.corrupt-N. The recording files themselves are untouched.
playercontrolpp.message.recording.save_f: [PlayerControl++] Failed to write the recording to disk; see the log for details.
playercontrolpp.message.baritone.pathing: [PlayerControl++] Baritone never started pathing. Check that it is enabled and that the target is reachable.
playercontrolpp.config.hotkeys.comment.m: Mark/unmark the container you are looking at as a restock target for auto-build-restock.
When enabled, automatically monitors #litematica builds and fetches materials from marked containers when the builder pauses on shortage.
Container positions for auto-restock. Each entry: dimension x y z. Use the Mark Container hotkey or edit this list directly.
playercontrolpp.config.hotkeys.comment.o: Start Baritone #litematica build AND enable auto-restock in one keypress.
When enabled, auto-restock will also take shulker boxes that contain needed materials from marked containers. Install QuickShulker to open them from inventory.
